claims.evidence: Witness confirms a white truck with an orange borehole drilling rig mounted on the rear.
Witness notes wear and scuffing on the front bumper and cab; overall aesthetic condition is not fully confirmed.
Witness report explicitly states operational status of the rig and hydraulic systems was not shown.

risks.risk: Hydraulic system or drilling motor failure
risks.proof: A video clip showing the mast being raised to vertical and the drill head rotating.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional rig requiring major repair

risks.risk: Truck engine or drivetrain mechanical issues
risks.proof: A video of the engine starting from cold and the truck moving through gears.

risks.risk: Undisclosed low drilling capacity or depth limits
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's specification plate on the drilling unit.
risks.if_unproven: at the lowest standard capacity for this truck class

risks.risk: Excessive tire wear or dry rot
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the tread on all three axles.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full set of replacement tires

proof_requests: Video of the drilling mast being raised and the drill head in operation.
Video of the truck engine running and the vehicle driving.
Photo of the drilling rig's technical specification plate.
Photo of the truck's instrument cluster showing mileage.
Photos of the truck cab interior.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the asset as a Nissan Diesel UD truck with a mounted drilling rig, allowing for a baseline valuation at its worst-case functional state.
